scope: 在不修改 core 的前提下切断 FP response-ready 清 payload 路径，并切分 FP_ITER ADD/SUB ap_pre 到 pp_pre 的指数对齐路径；保持 FP/NEON raw-bit、FPCR/FPSR、顺序提交和迭代 latency 协议。

implementation.summary: TX_DONE response handshake no longer clears rsp_r payload; rsp_valid remains state-qualified and reset/kill clear rsp_r. FP_ITER ADD/SUB now captures exponent-dependent sticky alignment in add_align{,_lo,_hi}, then IT_ALIGN generates fp_pre_t before the existing IT_PREP round/pack stage. FP_ITER it_divider kill/pause are connected to iter_kill/iter_pause.

response_contract.held_payload: rsp_r is not written while TX_DONE/backpressured
response_contract.consume: rsp_ready exits TX_DONE once; stale payload remains invalid until next TX_DONE overwrite
response_contract.reset_kill: rsp_r and transaction state clear to zero/idle

new_state.name: add_align/add_align_lo/add_align_hi and IT_ALIGN
new_state.reset_value: all zero; IT_ALIGN is 4'd8 and reset/kill state is IT_IDLE
new_state.architectural_commit: none; consumed by existing pp_pre -> IT_PREP -> slot response path

semantics.raw_bit: preserved; binary_pre_from_align mirrors binary_pre_parts special/zero/sign/flag behavior
semantics.fpcr_fpsr: FPCR snapshot, FZ/DN/RMode and FPSR sticky OR preserved
semantics.neon_lane: lane order and high-zero packing preserved
semantics.commit_order: single outstanding transaction and ordered slot commit preserved
